note: Model sheets built from descriptions in the source text. `appearance` lines are design notes with chapter references; `voice` is guidance for original writing, never transcription. `hair` drives the rig and the procedural stand-in. Palette values are linear RGB used by the actor rig and by glTF material overrides.

characters.name: Fang Yuan
characters.role: A demonic cultivator of five hundred years, returned to his fifteen-year-old body.

appearance.note: Long black hair, worn loose at home and gathered back with a plain cord outside. No ornament: he owns nothing worth wearing and would not wear it if he did.
Fifteen, ordinary build for his age, nothing the village would remark on. The gap between how harmless he looks and how he thinks is the whole design — do not make him look dangerous.
Plain dark student clothing through Act I: a cross-collared robe to mid-calf, sash, cloth shoes. An elder's robe after chapter 153, better cut and no better cared for.
A face that gives nothing away. Where other characters show what they feel, he is still — the inner-voice channel carries what the face does not.
Visibly drained after the blood curtain: the last stretch is played at Rank one with no healing Gu.

characters.voice: Cost-benefit arithmetic delivered flatly. He explains himself to no one. Inner lines are colder and shorter than anything he says aloud.

hair.note: Loose in the bamboo room at chapter 3; tied back from the awakening onward.

characters.name: Fang Zheng
characters.role: Fang Yuan's younger brother. A grade aptitude; the clan's chosen investment.

appearance.note: Open, earnest face. Carries himself like someone who has never been told no.
Better equipped than his peers from chapter 60 onward; the clan funds him.
Carried away toward Central Continent at the end, unconscious. This is a thread for the sequel, not a resolution.

characters.voice: Sincere, a little loud, genuinely wounded by his brother's coldness. Never written as stupid.

hair.note: Neater than his brother's, and kept that way for him.

characters.name: Fang Qiu
characters.role: The uncle who holds the brothers' inherited family assets.

appearance.note: Middle-aged, comfortable, well fed on other people's property. Dresses a step above his station.

characters.voice: Warm in public, arithmetic in private. Calls Fang Yuan 'nephew' most often when he is about to take something.

characters.name: Aunt Cui
characters.role: Fang Qiu's wife. The louder half of the household's hostility.

appearance.note: Sharp features, quick hands, a voice that carries across a courtyard.

characters.voice: Grievance delivered as hospitality. Every kindness has a bill attached.

characters.name: Elder Feng
characters.role: The academy elder who runs awakening and the Gu room.

appearance.note: Grey at the temples, unhurried, institutionally bored. Has read out a great many aptitude grades.

characters.voice: Procedural. Kindness where it costs nothing, paperwork where it does.

characters.name: Jia Fu
characters.role: The elder who opens the inquiry into Jia Jin Sheng's disappearance.

appearance.note: Controlled, formal, grieving in a way he will not display. Keeps his hands still.

characters.voice: Questions shaped like courtesies. He is not fooled; he is simply out of evidence.

characters.name: Jia Jin Sheng
characters.role: A clan youth who follows Fang Yuan onto the mountain at night and does not come back.

appearance.note: Confident, armed, used to being the stronger party. That assumption is the trap.

characters.voice: Bravado thinning into alarm. Only a handful of lines, and they have to land.

characters.name: Mo Yan
characters.role: The academy classmate whose family Fang Yuan extorts.

appearance.note: Well dressed for a student, soft-handed, surrounded by hangers-on who evaporate when pressed.

characters.voice: Indignation that keeps checking whether anyone important is listening.

characters.name: Mo Bei
characters.role: Mo Yan's father. Brings the family's weight to the classroom dispute.

appearance.note: Heavy, deliberate, dressed to be counted. Stands as though the room owes him the space.

characters.voice: Threat wrapped in family honour. Loses composure exactly once, and that is the scene.

characters.name: Elder Mo Chen
characters.role: The academy elder who moves against the extortion once it reaches him.

appearance.note: Lean, precise, genuinely competent — the first adult in the game who is a real obstacle.

characters.voice: Short sentences. Asks for facts and notices when he does not get them.

characters.name: Keeper Lu
characters.role: Keeps the Green Bamboo Wine tavern; later part of the property Fang Yuan takes over.

appearance.note: Apron, forearms, an accountant's memory for who owes what.

characters.voice: Friendly and entirely transactional. Will tell anyone anything for the price of a jar.

characters.name: Man Shi
characters.role: A large, simple clan youth; a troublemaker in the tavern loop and useful muscle.

appearance.note: Head and shoulders above everyone in the room, and entirely unaware of it.

characters.voice: Blunt, literal, oddly likeable. Never cruel on his own initiative.

characters.name: Jiang Ya
characters.role: Trades in vitality leaves; Fang Yuan's outlet for the leaf cultivation loop.

appearance.note: Careful hands, stained sleeves, the particular nervousness of someone handling goods worth more than they are.

characters.voice: Prices first, pleasantries after.

characters.name: Jiang He
characters.role: Lets Fang Yuan use his place; the cover for the secret Rank two advance.

appearance.note: Unremarkable on purpose. The kind of neighbour nobody questions.

characters.voice: Incurious, which is exactly what Fang Yuan is paying for.

characters.name: Jiao San
characters.role: Leads the winter mission group. Most of it does not come back.

appearance.note: Weathered, capable, carries the group's equipment himself. Written so his death costs something.

characters.voice: Practical leadership. Gives orders as though asking favours.

characters.name: Yao Le
characters.role: A clan girl who recognises Fang Yuan in the forest and asks him for help.

appearance.note: Rain-soaked, relieved to see a face she knows. Her trust is the whole weight of the scene.

characters.voice: Ordinary, warm, unguarded. Give her enough lines that she is a person before chapter 152.

characters.name: Yao Ji
characters.role: Searches the mountain for Yao Le. The search is an ongoing pressure, not a scene.

appearance.note: Gets thinner and less careful as the search goes on. Should be visible in the village between beats.

characters.voice: Asks the same question of everyone, in the same words, for weeks.

characters.name: Qing Shu
characters.role: Holds a position against the wolf tide. Fang Yuan watches; he does not help.

appearance.note: Older, scarred, fighting at the edge of what he has. The observer framing is the whole point of the scene.

characters.voice: No speeches. What he says is logistics until there is nothing left to organise.

characters.name: Bai Ning Bing
characters.role: Of the Bai clan. An uneasy ally with a grievance Fang Yuan holds the lever for.

appearance.note: One arm, before the Yin Gu. The model must ship in this state first — readers notice immediately.
After the Yin Gu restores the arm, and after the transformation at the end: pale, cold-toned, visibly changed.

characters.voice: Clipped, proud, contemptuous of being managed — and aware of being managed.

characters.name: Tie Ruo Nan
characters.role: Investigator. Works from evidence, and the evidence is whatever trail the player left.

appearance.note: Travelling clothes, notebook, the unhurried attention of someone who expects to be lied to.

characters.voice: Precise questions with long pauses after them. Never raises her voice.

characters.name: Tie Xue Leng
characters.role: The Divine Investigator the clan would rather not have to call.

appearance.note: Referred to long before he appears. Built heavy; stillness reads as threat.

characters.voice: Almost silent. When he speaks it is a conclusion, not a question.

characters.name: Chi Lian
characters.role: An elder whose apparent backing changes how the council reads Fang Yuan.

appearance.note: Dresses for the faction, not the person. Smiles on arrival and departure.

characters.voice: Public generosity, private accounting. Says 'we' about things he decided alone.

characters.name: Chi Zhong
characters.role: Inherits the medical administration and presses an order against the new elder.

appearance.note: Young for the post, conscious of it, overcorrects into formality.

characters.voice: Quotes regulations at people who outrank him.

characters.name: Elder Bo
characters.role: Speaks for the council when Fang Yuan's Rank three has to be acknowledged.

appearance.note: Old, tired, institutionally careful. Has outlived several factions.

characters.voice: Procedure as shelter. Will not be the one who says the dangerous thing.

characters.name: The first-generation Gu Yue
characters.role: The founder beneath the clan. What the clan's origin was actually for.

appearance.note: Staged at a scale the village scenes never use. The room has to feel too large for the player.

characters.voice: Speaks across centuries. No interest in the present generation except as material.

characters.name: Lord Sky Crane
characters.role: An old grudge arriving from Central Continent.

appearance.note: Pale robes, crane motif, arrives from above. Staged against the founder so both powers read as out of the player's league.

characters.voice: Courtesy as weapon. Treats the clan as furniture.

characters.name: The Flower Wine Monk
characters.role: Dead long before chapter 1. His cave, his remains, and his image wall.

appearance.note: Present only as remains and as figures on the image wall. Never animated in the present tense.

characters.voice: None. The wall speaks for him, and it contradicts the clan.

characters.name: Wang Da
characters.role: The hunter whose beast-skin map Fang Yuan takes, and who he then avoids.

appearance.note: Inferred from his hideout before he is seen: a portrait, a cooking fire, concealed markings on the map.

characters.voice: Territorial. Talks about the mountain as property.

characters.name: The Mo household servant
characters.role: Sent to deal with Fang Yuan over the extortion. The confrontation is a choice on screen; the blow is cut away from.

appearance.note: Livery, a cudgel, no expectation of resistance. Deliberately not a named villain.

characters.voice: Two or three lines of borrowed authority.

characters.name: Merchant Shen
characters.role: Runs the caravan's gambling-stone stall. The source of the fossil cover story.

appearance.note: Road-worn finery, rings, a showman's patter over a sharp ledger.

characters.voice: Sells uncertainty and knows it.

characters.name: Narrator
characters.role: Staging voice for things the camera shows and nobody says aloud. Used sparingly.

appearance.note: No model. Narrator lines render in the scene caption channel, never as a portrait.

characters.voice: Flat, specific, physical. Describes what is there, not how to feel about it.
